description: This file defines the BasketQueryService class which implements the IBasketQueryService interface. The class provides database query operations related to baskets, notably counting total basket items for a specific user, using Entity Framework Core.

classes.name: BasketQueryService
classes.description: A service class that provides query methods to retrieve basket information from the database.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously counts the total number of items in the basket for a given user by summing the quantities of all items.
